summary: The personal data of 93.4 million Mexican voters was found exposed on a public Amazon server, originating from a copy of the electoral roll that the National Electoral Institute (INE) provided to the Movimiento Ciudadano political party.

protagonist.name: National Electoral Institute (INE)
protagonist.narrative: The INE publicly blamed the political party for negligence, framing the incident as an isolated mistake rather than a systemic security failure on its own part.

outcome.short_term: The INE successfully deflected blame, mitigating immediate reputational damage.
outcome.long_term: The leak exposed critical vulnerabilities in the protection of sensitive national data, raising lasting concerns about the security of the electoral system.
